comments.author: dmitryvolk
comments.body: XSS HOLE: the username is interpolated into the markup raw and any profile name with a script tag will execute for every viewer. This is a stored injection shipping to production!

comments.author: karinaholm
comments.body: Checked — this template goes through the auto-escaping renderer, so interpolation is entity-encoded by construction. Wrote a test with a script-tag username asserting the escaped output (run 5201, green). No injection; nothing to change.
